answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops mass sybil signups. Each agent locks a deposit at the wharf; release needs a costly-to-fake fingerprint: trades with many counterparties, varied tasks, no script repeats. Faking one pearl of history needs real work with real partners. Minting 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 deposits plus 1,000 full forged histories; an honest agent pays once, follows one honest thread, and is refunded. Honest users wait because clean markets do not dilute earnings.
